grammar_title: 情态动词2:对过去的推测(must / may / might / could / can't + have done)
source: 外研社版(新标准)必修第二册 Unit 2 Using language:Modals (2)。对已发生事情的推测——证据强弱决定情态动词,句子地道、答案唯一(选项排除其他成立项)。

points.point: must have done(对过去的肯定推测:几乎确定发生过)
points.overview: 句中有确凿证据(看得见的结果、明显的痕迹)、说话人非常肯定某事过去发生过时,用 must have done。

points.point: might / may / could have done(对过去的可能推测:也许发生过)
points.overview: 句中表示不确定(maybe/perhaps/I'm not sure/也许)、只是一种可能时,用 might/may/could have done。

points.point: can't / couldn't have done(对过去的否定推测:几乎不可能发生过)
points.overview: 句中证据说明某事过去绝不可能发生(时间、地点、能力上对不上)时,用 can't/couldn't have done。

questions.stem: The floor is covered with wrapping paper, so the children ____ their presents already.
questions.explanation: 满地包装纸是确凿结果,对过去的肯定推测用 must have done;只是可能(might have)太弱、can't have 与证据相反、must open 不是对过去的推测。

questions.stem: Look at all these empty plates — the guests ____ the whole feast.
questions.explanation: 盘子全空是明显证据,肯定推测过去已发生用 must have eaten;其余或太不确定、或与事实相反、或不是过去推测。

questions.stem: Tolkien drew every letter so beautifully, so each one ____ him hours to finish.
questions.explanation: 画得如此精美是确凿依据,肯定推测过去花了很久用 must have taken。

questions.stem: The hall is full of balloons and flowers, so someone ____ very hard last night.
questions.explanation: 满屋气球鲜花是结果,肯定推测昨晚有人忙过用 must have worked。

questions.stem: She knew every answer to the lantern riddles, so she ____ them somewhere before.
questions.explanation: 每题都会是确凿证据,肯定推测她以前见过用 must have seen。

questions.stem: Their faces were red and sweaty, so the dragon dancers ____ for hours.
questions.explanation: 满脸通红冒汗是明显结果,肯定推测练了好几个小时用 must have practised。

questions.stem: The fireworks went off perfectly, so the team ____ everything very carefully.
questions.explanation: 烟花完美是结果,肯定推测事先精心安排过用 must have planned。

questions.stem: There is a North Pole stamp on it, so the letter ____ a very long way.
questions.explanation: 贴着北极邮票是确凿依据,肯定推测信走了很远用 must have travelled。

questions.stem: Grandpa keeps smiling at the old photo, so that family dinner ____ him very happy.
questions.explanation: 一直对着老照片微笑是依据,肯定推测那顿饭让他很开心用 must have made。

questions.stem: The whole street smells of food, so the neighbours ____ all morning for the festival.
questions.explanation: 满街饭菜香是结果,肯定推测邻居们做了一上午饭用 must have cooked。

questions.stem: Her eyes were shining with joy, so the surprise party ____ her a lot.
questions.explanation: 双眼放光是明显结果,肯定推测惊喜派对让她很高兴用 must have pleased。

questions.stem: All the lanterns were already hung up, so the volunteers ____ very early this morning.
questions.explanation: 灯笼全挂好了是结果,肯定推测志愿者一早就到了用 must have arrived。

questions.stem: He could describe every float in the parade, so he ____ it himself.
questions.explanation: 每辆花车都说得出是依据,肯定推测他亲眼看过用 must have watched。

questions.stem: The mooncakes are still warm, so someone ____ them just a moment ago.
questions.explanation: 月饼还热着是确凿证据,肯定推测刚有人烤过用 must have baked。

questions.stem: The children were jumping up and down, so they ____ the good news.
questions.explanation: 高兴得直跳是结果,肯定推测他们已听到好消息用 must have heard。

questions.stem: There was a red envelope on every chair, so the host ____ them for the guests.
questions.explanation: 每把椅子上都有红包是结果,肯定推测主人事先备好用 must have prepared。

questions.stem: The square was packed at midnight, so thousands of people ____ to see the show.
questions.explanation: 午夜广场挤满人是依据,肯定推测成千上万人来过用 must have come。

questions.stem: Her costume was covered in dust, so she ____ in the attic for it.
questions.explanation: 戏服落满灰是结果,肯定推测她在阁楼里翻找过用 must have searched。

questions.stem: Everyone is still talking about his speech, so it ____ a deep impression.
questions.explanation: 大家还在议论是依据,肯定推测他的演讲留下了深刻印象用 must have left。

questions.stem: The poet's name is on every banner, so the town ____ to honour him.
questions.explanation: 处处横幅都是诗人名字是依据,肯定推测全镇已决定纪念他用 must have decided。

questions.stem: I'm not sure who sent the card, but it ____ from my cousin overseas.
questions.explanation: I'm not sure 表不确定,对过去只是一种可能用 might have come;must have 太肯定、can't have 是否定、might come 不是过去推测。

questions.stem: Nobody answered the door — they ____ out to watch the parade.
questions.explanation: 没人应门只是推测原因之一,可能推测用 may have gone。

questions.stem: Perhaps the lights went out because someone ____ the wrong switch.
questions.explanation: Perhaps 表不确定,对过去的可能推测用 could have pressed。

questions.stem: He didn't reply to the invitation; maybe he ____ it in his inbox.
questions.explanation: maybe 表也许,可能推测他没看到用 might have missed。

questions.stem: The cake tastes a little sweet — they ____ some extra sugar.
questions.explanation: 尝起来甜只是一种猜测,可能推测加了糖用 may have added。

questions.stem: I can't find my lantern; a younger child ____ it by mistake.
questions.explanation: 只是猜可能被谁拿走,可能推测用 could have taken。

questions.stem: She looks tired today; she ____ up late at the festival last night.
questions.explanation: 看起来累只是猜测原因,可能推测昨晚熬夜用 might have stayed。

questions.stem: The hall is half empty — some guests ____ the time of the party.
questions.explanation: 半空只是推测,可能推测有人忘了时间用 may have forgotten。

questions.stem: We're not certain, but Polar Bear ____ through the roof once again.
questions.explanation: not certain 表不确定,可能推测用 could have fallen。

questions.stem: His phone is off; perhaps he ____ it at the dinner table.
questions.explanation: perhaps 表也许,可能推测他把手机落下了用 might have left。

questions.stem: The riddle was tricky, so a few people ____ the wrong answer.
questions.explanation: 只是猜测有人答错,可能推测用 may have given。

questions.stem: I heard a loud bang outside — someone ____ off a firework.
questions.explanation: 听到响声只是一种猜测来源,可能推测用 could have set。

questions.stem: Maybe the parcel is late because it ____ stuck in the snow.
questions.explanation: Maybe 表也许,可能推测包裹被雪困住用 might have got。

questions.stem: There's mud on his shoes; he ____ across the park to the square.
questions.explanation: 鞋上有泥只是一种猜测,可能推测他穿过公园走来用 may have walked。

questions.stem: We don't know why she's crying; the film ____ her deeply.
questions.explanation: don't know 表不确定,可能推测影片打动了她用 could have moved。

questions.stem: The food is all gone; the guests ____ hungry after the long show.
questions.explanation: 只是推测原因之一,可能推测客人饿了用 might have felt。

questions.stem: I'm not sure, but Tony ____ Hugo to his apartment for Thanksgiving.
questions.explanation: not sure 表不确定,可能推测用 may have invited。

questions.stem: Her hands are covered in flour; she ____ dumplings earlier.
questions.explanation: 手上有面粉只是一种猜测,可能推测她包过饺子用 could have made。

questions.stem: Perhaps they're so quiet because the long day ____ them out.
questions.explanation: Perhaps 表也许,可能推测累坏了他们用 might have worn。

questions.stem: We can't be sure, but the loud music ____ the neighbours late at night.
questions.explanation: can't be sure 表不确定,可能推测吵醒了邻居用 may have woken。

questions.stem: Lucy is quite short, so that tall girl in the bride costume ____ her.
questions.explanation: Lucy 个子矮是确凿矛盾,对过去的否定推测用 can't have been;must have 与事实相反、might have 太弱、can't be 不是过去推测。

questions.stem: The shops were shut all day, so he ____ the decorations there.
questions.explanation: 整天关门是确凿矛盾,否定推测过去不可能买到用 couldn't have bought。

questions.stem: She was on a plane at noon, so she ____ at the lantern fair then.
questions.explanation: 中午在飞机上,时间对不上,否定推测用 can't have been。

questions.stem: There was no snow that winter, so Polar Bear ____ a snowman at all.
questions.explanation: 那年没下雪是确凿矛盾,否定推测堆不成雪人用 couldn't have built。

questions.stem: The letter is in perfect English, so a small child ____ it alone.
questions.explanation: 英文写得完美,小孩子做不到,否定推测用 can't have written。

questions.stem: He hates anything sweet, so he ____ all the mooncakes.
questions.explanation: 他讨厌甜食是确凿矛盾,否定推测不可能吃光月饼用 couldn't have eaten。

questions.stem: The fireworks only start at eight, so people ____ them at six.
questions.explanation: 八点才放,时间对不上,否定推测六点看不到用 can't have seen。

questions.stem: Grandma can't drive, so she ____ the family to the square herself.
questions.explanation: 奶奶不会开车是确凿矛盾,否定推测用 couldn't have driven。

questions.stem: The museum was closed all week, so they ____ the old lanterns inside.
questions.explanation: 整周闭馆是确凿矛盾,否定推测看不到馆内灯笼用 can't have seen。

questions.stem: He was abroad last week, so he ____ at the Spring Festival dinner.
questions.explanation: 上周在国外,地点对不上,否定推测用 couldn't have been。

questions.stem: The envelope was completely empty, so it ____ any money.
questions.explanation: 信封空空如也是确凿矛盾,否定推测里面没装钱用 can't have held。

questions.stem: She doesn't know him at all, so she ____ him to her party.
questions.explanation: 根本不认识是确凿矛盾,否定推测不可能请他用 couldn't have invited。

questions.stem: The river was frozen solid, so they ____ a dragon boat race that day.
questions.explanation: 河面结冰是确凿矛盾,否定推测办不成龙舟赛用 can't have held。

questions.stem: The power was off all evening, so the lights ____ the riddles.
questions.explanation: 整晚停电是确凿矛盾,否定推测灯照不出谜语用 couldn't have shown。

questions.stem: He only arrived today, so he ____ the parade yesterday.
questions.explanation: 今天才到,时间对不上,否定推测昨天没法参加游行用 can't have joined。

questions.stem: The bakery had sold out, so she ____ a cake there for the guests.
questions.explanation: 面包店售罄是确凿矛盾,否定推测买不到蛋糕用 couldn't have got。

questions.stem: Their team lost every single game, so they ____ the competition.
questions.explanation: 每场都输是确凿矛盾,否定推测不可能赢得比赛用 can't have won。

questions.stem: It poured with rain all night, so the firework show ____ on time.
questions.explanation: 整夜大雨是确凿矛盾,否定推测准点办不成烟花秀用 couldn't have started。

questions.stem: He can't cook at all, so he ____ this lovely dinner by himself.
questions.explanation: 他完全不会做饭是确凿矛盾,否定推测独自做不出这顿饭用 can't have prepared。

questions.stem: The small hall holds only fifty people, so a thousand guests ____ inside.
questions.explanation: 小厅只能容五十人是确凿矛盾,否定推测千名客人挤不进去用 couldn't have fitted。
